reviews.name: Akhil Saju
reviews.quote: Pink Event Planners did an amazing job coordinating and managing the event. Everything was handled very professionally, and the stage and arrangements looked absolutely awesome. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Anila
reviews.quote: We had an amazing experience with Pink Event Planner! Everything was beautifully arranged, from the stage decor to the smallest details. reviews.quote: I contacted Pink event without seeing their work anywhere and with some doubt in my mind. I was very happy seeing him although the event also ensuring there is nothing wrong happens.

reviews.name: Aswini Abraham
reviews.quote: We are absolutely happy with the stage decor for our baby's baptism! The entire setup was elegant and classy with beautiful floral arrangements. The attention to detail was amazing, from the welcome board to stage and lighting. It created the perfect atmosphere for such a meaningful day.

reviews.name: Anju Benny
reviews.quote: Had a great experience with Pink Event for our baby’s baptism! Rino handled everything so smoothly and the stage setup looked beautiful. Super easy to work with and very professional. Highly recommend!
